description: Side-by-side comparison. Countries: pass 2 or more and a topic (e.g. tax_systems, cost_of_living, banking, safety, passport_power) for the source rows, or no topic for each country's headline summary. Programs: pass 2 to 8 program ids or names for minimums, citizenship time, stay rules, processing time and fees. Rankings: omit items and pass topic passport_power, crypto_adoption or human_freedom for the whole published ranking.

items.description: Countries (e.g. ["Panama", "costa-rica"]) or programs (e.g. ["program:panama-pensionado", "Paraguay investor"]); do not mix the two.

topic.description: For countries: the dataset topic to compare on. Dataset topic, e.g. "tax_systems", "digital_nomad_visas" or "cost_of_living".

name: compare
title: Compare countries or programs
